visual_action: A montage of clips from a large, professionally produced combat sports event held at night on the lawn of the White House. The video shows Donald Trump and Dana White on a balcony, with Trump saluting. It cuts to scenes of fighters in an octagonal ring, a fighter holding an American flag with the Presidential Seal in the background, a wide shot of the ring in front of the White House with a large crowd, and Trump shaking a fighter's hand at ringside.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is shown on screen multiple times at the event, including saluting on a balcony and interacting with a fighter. The event is implicitly framed as a representation of his administration's priorities.

cast.name: Dana White
cast.evidence: He is shown standing next to Donald Trump in the opening shot of the video.

on_screen_text.text: no money for healthcare but don't worry we can afford this shit

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video. The audio consists entirely of a music track.
audio_music: The upbeat, high-energy hip-hop track 'Baby Got Back' by Sir Mix-A-Lot plays throughout the entire video, creating a party-like and ironic atmosphere for the event being criticized.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage with fast cuts between different scenes of the event.
central_claim: The Trump administration has misplaced priorities, spending money on lavish events like a combat sport competition at the White House instead of funding healthcare.
intended_effect: To provoke anger and criticism towards Donald Trump's perceived wasteful spending and disregard for essential services like healthcare.
